provenance: Opus 5.5 subscription CLI draft with host review/repairs, source restrictions and execution verification.

draft_notes.explanation: Every 4-connected group of the original colour 3 that has at least 2 cells is recoloured to the original colour 8. Isolated single cells of colour 3 stay as they are. Edge adjacency (up, down, left, right) is the same under all eight D4 transforms, so the emitted program needs no axis or direction changes and works directly on the visible grid. The palette only changes the constants: the program looks for palette[3] cells and writes palette[8]. The background colour palette[0] is never referenced. Nothing is inferred from the demonstrations.
draft_notes.limitations: This assumes the generator's domain: only background and colour 3 appear in inputs, and grids are 3 to 6 cells on each side (the code itself works for any rectangular grid). It also assumes the generator's edgefree_pixels means cells with no edge-adjacent neighbour of the same colour, which matches all approved fixtures. No fixture contradicts this uniform rule. I have not run any tests.
